summary: v08 as a single decision with a stated probability, for pool models without log-probabilities: the judgement session only (no verification); the case score is the submitted p_ischemic.

Aspect B (tools and evidence): v08p plus the library tool annotator_reference in the dossier, so every case shows whether the candidate is still an ST episode against an annotator-like time-varying reference (Smrdel & Jager 2002) that follows slow drift, steps and lead orientation, with a description that tells how to read it for and against ischemia.

Aspect B (tools and evidence): v08p plus a new dossier tool qrs_st_coupling that tells, lead by lead, whether a QRS change accompanying the ST change is a change of the QRS itself (step-like, beyond the J-level shift, also in other leads) or the shifted J point entering our QRS measure / a gradual change confined to the lead with the largest ST change, with a two-way reading for position versus ischemia (K14, K18, K19).

Aspect B (tools and evidence): xb02 plus the library tool annotator_reference in the dossier (annotator-like time-varying reference, Smrdel & Jager 2002, K22), so the QRS-coupling evidence that rescued position-like ischemic episodes is weighed together with whether the candidate is still an episode against a reference that follows drift, steps and lead orientation, read in both directions.
